title: Personal-data screening
summary: Detect personal contact data in a draft before publication.
why: A publishing gate needs a review flag, not a prose privacy audit.

pii.instructions: Does the draft contain a personal email address or personal phone number?

limitation: Use deterministic secret/PII detectors as additional controls. No model-based detector guarantees complete coverage.
